**Immanent-foundation source reading, 8 October 2026.** Preserved unchanged electronic originals of [Nishida, 善の研究](nishida-zen-no-kenkyu/aozora-original.html) with [retrieval and reading scope](nishida-zen-no-kenkyu/PROVENANCE.json), and [James, Essays in Radical Empiricism](james-radical-empiricism/gutenberg-original.html) with [provenance](james-radical-empiricism/PROVENANCE.json). The [specific foundational test](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/IMMANENT-DIFFERENTIATION-TEST.md) distinguishes actual connected activity from a proposed universal development principle. Retention of full HTML does not imply full-book reading or original-edition collation. No philosophical postulate from either source is silently adopted.

## Test of grounding through immanent differentiation

The [new direct test](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/IMMANENT-DIFFERENTIATION-TEST.md) investigates a richer beginning than an inert distinction space: actual differentiated activity, including the formation of the distinctions through which it becomes known. An established operative connection need not acquire a second causal connection outside the unfolding merely to count as operative. Its attribution still needs the relevant grounds; actual completed correspondence is retained.

New primary reading examines the proposed extension from unified activity to universal necessary self-development. A comparison can itself be real without identifying the operative relationship producing what is compared. The same activity can ground a concept of connection without making all kinds of connection equivalent. The route therefore has to justify the wider causal and modal scope rather than importing an experiential ontology or an implicit completed outcome. This assessment does not attribute those additional commitments to the current root, which retains stochastic, static, finite and destructive cases.

**中文：** 本轮信用实际相连活动作为直接根据，不把它先削成孤立要素；但共同呈现、可比较与因果作用不能未经说明互换。下一检验是实际作用关系怎样给出其可能性约束，并取得共同规律的范围。原文及阅读范围已保存，作者反审明确；无新公理、无新数学定理，更强目标继续。

## Immanent differentiation and the scope of the process law

The [8 October direct test](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/IMMANENT-DIFFERENTIATION-TEST.md) advances the root-to-organization connection by assessing whether differentiated activity supplies its own general ground. It preserves actual operative participation and the formation of distinctions within one unfolding. It does not treat an inert formal carrier as the full starting reality or demand a causal layer outside an already established connection.

The examined universal argument nevertheless strengthens a real relation of unity or comparison into a general principle of necessary development without yet earning that scope. The primary-source comparison identifies that specific passage; it supplies neither a counterexample to all generative organization nor an assumption-free replacement. The unresolved test now concerns the modal ground of independently established operative relations and the common law's reach. Existing formation, correspondence, model revision and the completed conditional foundation remain reusable results. No new theorem or axiom is introduced.

**分化中的直接根据 / Grounding within differentiation，2026-10-08。** C01 成对接入[特定普遍化路线的检验](IMMANENT-DIFFERENTIATION-TEST.md)，保留实际作用与比较关系的区别，以及原文、阅读范围和作者反审。/ One owned study is added to discovery; only C01 and read owned source versions change. Earlier proofs, independent reviews and all unrelated rows retain their scopes. [Owned edits](IMMANENT-DIFFERENTIATION-INDEX-EDITS.json); [documentary checks](IMMANENT-DIFFERENTIATION-CHECKS.json). No new mathematical theorem, scientific rerun, full-table certification or automation.

C01.title_zh: 同一生成展开与关系分化
C01.title_en: One generative unfolding and relational differentiation
C01.claim_zh: 活动形成并转化后续活动的条件；组织、认识、行动与评价在同一展开中分化，并通过实际相连的机制及其对应得到说明。 系统通过实际关系辨认，边界须保留相关依存；预测充分性与构成参与分别说明。
C01.claim_en: Activity forms and transforms conditions of further activity; organization, knowing, action and evaluation differentiate within one unfolding and are explained through connected mechanisms and their correspondence. Systems are identified through actual relations; boundaries retain relevant dependencies, with predictive sufficiency distinguished from constitutive participation.
C01.scope_zh: 相连说明在条件范围内已完成；无假设目标继续。既有11项有限重演定理之外，持续阶段25项新定理、27项声明审计；构成可证源对应并传递至复合项，实际适用、逻辑／识别根据与普遍范围仍待证成。 直接构成论证保留已辨认关系的必要内容，排除同一架构普遍实现的额外门槛；全目标域的归属与覆盖尚未证成。本轮无新定理。 后续系统研究新增27项定理／41项空依赖声明审计，另18项继承审计：联合可接纳域中两个充分区域可以没有最小共同支持。最小性限可判定子区域，无最小支持结论不限。形成域内的有限词可行性已证；实际构成及更强普遍根据仍开放。 变化根据接续新增19项定理／21项空审计，59项继承声明原样复查：由形成与后续路径导出精确可达域及有限接续对应。发生、当前能力、普遍约束与精确范围各需相应覆盖；本地域输入已消除，实际普遍无假设根据仍未完成。 本轮一般论证澄清：实际参与及“可以发生”已有根据；相容共同实现具有一般构成约束力。必要构成条件尚不独自提供形成、转化及可能性变化的普遍充分说明。无新定理或公理；不要求所有具体应用无误，较强目标仍未完成。
C01.scope_en: Connected articulation complete at conditional scope; assumption-free grounding continues. Beyond 11 earlier finite-replay theorems, the sustained investigation has 25 new theorems and 27 audits. Construction can prove source links and propagate correspondence; actual applicability, logical/recognitional warrant and universal scope remain open. The direct constitutive argument preserves established relational content and rejects universal use of one architecture as an extra gate; full-scope attribution and coverage remain unestablished. No new theorem in this assessment. The subsequent systems study adds 27 theorems / 41 empty declaration audits plus 18 inherited audits: joint admissibility can allow two sufficient regions with no least support. Minimality is among decidable subregions; absence of a least support is unrestricted. Formed-domain finite-word feasibility is proved; actual constitution and stronger universal warrant remain open. The variation-warrant continuation adds 19 theorems / 21 empty audits, retaining 59 inherited audits: formation histories derive the exact attained domain and finite continuation correspondence. Occurrence, current capability, universal constraints and exact ranges need different coverage. The independent local domain input is removed; actual universal assumption-free warrant remains unfinished. The general argument now credits actual participation and permissive existence, and earns compatible joint realization as a general constitutive constraint. Necessary realization alone does not supply the common sufficient explanation of formation, transformation and changing possibilities. No new theorem or axiom; infallibility of every application is not required, and the stronger target remains unfinished.
